rows.reason: Arm 1 skips a Session whose assembled brief list is empty. `assembleSessionBriefs` builds one list per Session by filtering out heads with no brief (node-detail-reader.ts:566-568); a list is empty only when `assembleLineRows` got no ready row for the Session's head, which happens only at the `not_found` return of `assembleOneLine` (node-detail-reader.ts:344-346), i.e. when `readSession` finds no Session record, cannot decode it, or finds it in another project/workspace (work-line-reader.ts:631-634). No upstream check prevents that state: `resolveContinuationLine` returns the anchor's own ref as the head without verifying it exists (work-line-reader.ts:1445-1447, :1473), and `listSessionAnomalies` decodes and returns the stored anchor records without cross-checking that the Session exists (session-anomaly-service.ts:249-279, :663-664). So an anchor row whose Session record is missing, undecodable or foreign — a hand-edited/corrupted store, an old-format record, or the scripted foreign port answer the old test used (before test `.dsh-ref/before/tests/work-graph/S2C-node-detail-anomalies.test.ts:30-31` names the never-created `s1`) — reaches arm 1. Claude's chain correctly shows that only `not_found` empties the list and that the writer guards a real Session (session-anomaly-service.ts:583), but that proves only that no platform writer produces the shape; it does not make the arm unreachable, because the store can hold an anchor whose Session row is absent and no read-time check rejects or cross-checks it. That is exactly U, not D2. The old test did not assert `line` at all; it covered the arm only incidentally through the fabricated anchor.
rows.proposal: Keep the missing-Session guard and leave it untested; do not restore the fabricated `s1` anchor test (AGENTS.md rule 4 and decision 79: no test that only tampering or a foreign writer can trigger). Deleting the guard would be behaviour-preserving, since the `?? null` at node-detail-reader.ts:1393 turns an undefined map value into null, so if the lead prefers no redundant guard, drop the condition at :1387; either way add no forged-anchor test.
